name: localstore
description: Local tool store with development capabilities

scripts.build: npm -C frontend ci && npm -C frontend run build
scripts.prod: npm -C frontend ci && npm -C frontend run build && cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && FLASK_DEBUG=0 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 python fastapi_app.py
scripts.backend: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && python fastapi_app.py
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n back,front -c blue,magenta "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
